title: Learning Adaptive Deliberation Control for Reliable Recognition with Multi-Agent Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.17840v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent deliberation can improve recognition by criticizing and revising candidate answers, but fixed controls cannot respond to changes in disagreement or reasoning quality. We present an adaptive multi-agent controller (ADMA) that learns continuous policies for proposal, challenge, arbitration, and coordination while keeping the task model frozen. Shared trace features describe quality, agreement, and progress, while role-specific features support decentralized control during inference. One controller trained on legal and financial reasoning is transferred without policy updates to four textual and multimodal benchmarks and two successive task-model versions. With Qwen3.5 held fixed, ADMA-Full improves accuracy by 6.2-14.2 percentage points over Direct and by 2.8-3.0 points over ADMA-Fixed. Paired bootstrap ranges for the Full-Fixed comparison are positive on three tasks. Outcome decompositions show that recoveries exceed introduce

translated_title: 学习多智能体语言模型的自适应审议控制以实现可靠识别
translated_abstract: 多智能体审议可以通过对候选答案进行批评和修订来提升识别效果，但固定的控制方式无法响应分歧程度或推理质量的变化。我们提出了一种自适应多智能体控制器（ADMA），它在保持任务模型冻结的同时，学习针对提议、挑战、仲裁和协调的连续策略。共享的轨迹特征用于描述质量、一致性和进度，而角色特定特征则支持推理过程中的去中心化控制。仅在一个法律和金融推理任务上训练的控制器，无需任何策略更新即可迁移到四个文本和多模态基准测试以及两个连续版本的任务模型上。在Qwen3.5保持固定的情况下，ADMA-Full 相比 Direct 方法将准确率提升了6.2至14.2个百分点，相比 ADMA-Fixed 提升了2.8至3.0个百分点。Full-Fixed 对比的配对自助法置信区间在三个任务上均为正值。结果分解表明，修正错误的效果超过了引入新错误的效果。
tldr: 提出自适应多智能体控制器ADMA，通过学习提议、挑战、仲裁和协调的连续策略，在任务模型保持冻结的情况下无需策略更新即可跨任务和模型版本迁移，显著提升多智能体审议的识别准确率。
en_tdlr: ADMA, an adaptive multi-agent controller that learns continuous policies for proposal, challenge, arbitration, and coordination while keeping the task model frozen, transfers across textual and multimodal benchmarks and successive model versions without policy updates, improving recognition accuracy over direct and fixed-control deliberation.
